dedupe_keys.name: estadisticas agricolas de los distritos de riego conagua irrigation district statistics mexico 1998 to 2025

description: CONAGUA, Mexico's national water commission, publishes agricultural and hydrometric statistics of the country's irrigation districts, the large public irrigation schemes run with water user associations. The page read on 2026-09-28 offers yearly editions from 1998 to the 2017-2018 cycle and three Excel compendia now covering 1998 to 2025: statistics by district (area sown and harvested, yield, production, average rural price and production value by district, cycle, irrigation mode and crop), statistics by crop, and irrigated areas and distributed volumes by district (number of irrigating users, physical area irrigated, gross volume taken from supply sources and average irrigation depth); it notes a production of 58.3 million tonnes in 2018-2019, the highest in 31 years. Coverage is national, for all irrigation districts. Access is free download; no licence is stated beyond the portal terms. Caveats: volumes are reported by user associations and CONAGUA, and district boundaries and names change over time. It supports capacity planning and drought adaptation studies of irrigation water demand and supply by district. Related records: data-conagua-irrigation-units-agricultural-statistics covers the smaller irrigation units.
